title: Glial-regulated continuous quaternion neurite transport, independent viability and contextual distinction
status: proposed, not frozen, not executed, no held-out results
goal: Evaluate whether resource-accounted glial participation and experience-updated continuous quaternionic tendril connections improve adaptation and viable growth under matched resource, information and compute budgets.
controls: G0-AF without glia under identical total external nutrient inflow
glial positive resource transfer only, no calcium tripartite modulation
pairwise hidden-state controller with matched storage (ternary reducibility null)
fixed-neurite topology with equal parameter and storage capacity
Q8-only inherited phases without continuous quaternionic repair
continuous quaternion model with transport phase randomization
ordinary real-valued state estimator with identical observation history
split-step numerical integrator converged to same full joint generator
invariants: zero total AF-plus-glial energy ledger residual with internal transfer subtracted
nonnegative finite chemical, substrate, ATP proxy, glial stores and bounded ranks
unit-quaternion norm and independent local left gauge covariance
pruned continuous section and old connection preserved as typed audit remainder
all CTMC offdiagonal rates >= 0 and outgoing row sum zero
paired_metrics: task-conditional false equivalence under heldout contexts
action quality conditional on available evidence
neurite growth utility rather than total length
persistent, useful contacts and recovery following simulated lesion
local transport mismatch across unseen frame changes
resource exhaustion, proxy spend and total tissue viability
wall/CPU time, measured peak RAM, simulated resource counts
main_hypotheses: Glial regulation improves resource-limited transport adaptation at equal external nutrient spending.
Continuous transport improves heldout context recovery compared with Q8-only at equal effective capacity.
Ternary support offers a discriminating benefit over a resource- and hidden-state-matched pairwise model.
kill_conditions: No relative advantage once hidden-state pairwise controls have matching information and resources.
Equivalent 4-real-coordinate arithmetic ties: do not claim intrinsic quaternion speed or generalization advantage.
Transport repair fits seen pairs but fails unseen transformations or fresh frames.
Extra glial resources merely subsidize the model rather than deliver regulatory benefit.
False growth, resource exhaustion or abstention increases enough to negate task gain.
Any hidden evaluator-only semantic or transport-truth channel enters the learner.
dependency: G0-AE -> G0-AF -> G0-AG (stacked draft PRs); earlier frozen G0-F/AC/Y results unchanged
promotion: An independent, preregistered heldout experiment with matched controls and explicit uncertainty must exist before H can become M.
